sloka: अनाहारो निरालोको धनहीनो यथा द्विज: ।शेष्ये पुरस्तात् शालाया यावन्न प्रतियास्यति ॥ २.१११.१४॥
transliteration: anāhāro nirāloko dhanahīno yathā dvija: ।śeṣye purastāt śālāyā yāvanna pratiyāsyati ॥ 2.111.14॥

translations.english: Like a poor brahmin, starving, my face muffled, I shall lie down in front of the hut until he agrees to return.
